rationale.consistency: trimPathSuffix mirrors trimPathPrefix's structure, naming, url.PathUnescape use, EqualFold case-folding and comment style; helper placed next to its sibling.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles decoded-vs-encoded match, literal escape in suffix, empty suffix/path, case-insensitive hex; only a marginal quirk with double-encoded '%25' where suffix '%' is decoded rather than literal.
rationale.scope: Only replaces the broken reverse-based suffix trim and removes the now-dead reverse helper; prefix, query and other rewrites untouched.
rationale.readability: Doc comment explains why backward walking needs the suffix-escape check; clear index names; inherits the slightly garbled 'to consistency with' comment wording.
rationale.robustness: All slice indexes guarded (iPath>=2, iSuffix>=2, iPath+1>=0); unescape error returns path unchanged; no allocation beyond the prefix version's pattern.
rationale.maintainability: Duplicates the loop shape of trimPathPrefix instead of sharing, but the two directions differ enough that this is defensible and each stays self-contained.
